name: lmo
description: LMO (from the BOP benchmark) measures 6D object pose estimation performance on real-world images, often with heavy occlusion and clutter. It evaluates algorithms' ability to detect objects and recover their full 3D pose (translation and rotation) from RGB or RGB-D inputs. The dataset is used to benchmark methods in robotics and augmented reality that require precise pose estimates under occlusion.
reputation: A well-known and widely used benchmark in the 6D pose estimation and robotics vision communities as part of the BOP suite.
